theorems.name: Escauriaza-Seregin-Sverak (2003)
theorems.applicability_to_bridge1: Matches observed bounded local L3 norm. Missing assumption: global L3 whole-space control without spatial energy loss at infinity.

theorems.name: Constantin-Fefferman (1993) / Deng-Hou-Yu (2005)
theorems.conclusion: Smooth solution extends across interval without blow-up if directions remain Lipschitz / cone-confined.
theorems.applicability_to_bridge1: Directly supported by BRIDGE1 double-cone angle diagnostic (theta <= 35 deg).

theorems.name: Seregin (2012) / Koch-Tataru (2001)
theorems.solution_class: Type-I blow-up limits in BMO^-1 / L3,infty
theorems.conclusion: Rigidity and exclusion of nontrivial self-similar/ancient limits under suitable decay.
